request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and sincere, piano, acoustic guitar, soft strings, light percussion, hopeful and uplifting, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Walking in the light as He is in the light
Fellowship with one another shines
No more lying when the truth is near
We do not practice what is clear

[Pre-Chorus]
If we claim no sin we deceive ourselves
The truth is missing from our lives
But in the dark we cannot stay
We must turn and find the way

[Chorus]
If we confess our sins
He is faithful and just
He will forgive our sins
And cleanse us as we trust
From all unrighteousness
His love never ends
Faithful and just

[Verse]
Saying we have sinned makes Him a liar
His word is not in us
But when we speak the truth we find
A heart that is kind and blind
To no confession that is real
His grace is pure and steel

[Pre-Chorus]
The blood of Jesus cleanses us
From all sin and all abuse
We walk together in the light
Our shadows fade from sight

[Chorus]
If we confess our sins
He is faithful and just
He will forgive our sins
And cleanse us as we trust
From all unrighteousness
His love never ends
Faithful and just

[Chorus]
If we confess our sins
He is faithful and just
He will forgive our sins
And cleanse us as we trust
From all unrighteousness
His love never ends
Faithful and just

[Outro]
Faithful and just
He hears our trust
